name: Patient List for TB ART MER Indicator Report

config.sql: SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM ((SELECT DISTINCT o.person_id AS patient_id FROM obs o INNER JOIN encounter e ON o.encounter_id = e.encounter_id WHERE o.concept_id = 159792 AND (o.value_coded IN (159793, 160108, 164084)) AND e.encounter_datetime BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate AND o.voided = 0 AND e.voided = 0) new_relapsed_tb INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT e.patient_id FROM encounter e WHERE e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND e.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND e.voided = 0) hiv_positive ON new_relapsed_tb.patient_id = hiv_positive.patient_id) UNION ALL (SELECT DISTINCT o.person_id AS patient_id FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid IN ('e1d84780-c736-4f2b-8724-82e1fd7ed08d', 'e1d81c60-c736-4f2b-8724-82e1fd7ed08d', 'e1d84480-c736-4f2b-8724-82e1fd7ed08d')) AND o.value_coded IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid IN ('703', '664')) AND o.obs_datetime BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate AND o.voided = 0 INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT e.patient_id FROM encounter e INNER JOIN obs tb ON e.encounter_id = tb.encounter_id WHERE tb.concept_id = 159792 AND tb.value_coded IN (159793, 160108, 164084) AND e.encounter_datetime BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate AND tb.voided = 0 AND e.voided = 0) new_tb_patients ON o.person_id = new_tb_patients.patient_id)
